headline: Cristiano Ronaldo becomes first player to score in six World Cups
summary: The 41-year-old Portuguese superstar reaches a historic landmark in a Group K tie against Uzbekistan in Houston.
details: Portuguese striker Cristiano Ronaldo has etched his name into football history by becoming the first player to score in six different World Cups.
The 41-year-old reached the landmark in the sixth minute of Portugal’s Group K match against Uzbekistan in Houston on Tuesday.
Ronaldo finished a cross from João Cancelo to put the ball in the net, ending a 10-match goal drought in major international tournaments.
This goal marked his 144th international goal in 230 appearances, both of which are current records for men's internationals.
Having made his World Cup debut in 2006, Ronaldo has scored in every single finals since then.
His goal against Uzbekistan also equalled Eusebio's record of nine goals at the global finals for Portugal.
caption:
6 World Cups, 1 legend. Cristiano Ronaldo just made history again.

Portuguese striker Cristiano Ronaldo has etched his name into football history by becoming the first player to score in six different World Cups.

The 41-year-old reached the landmark in the sixth minute of Portugal’s Group K match against Uzbekistan in Houston on Tuesday.

Ronaldo finished a cross from João Cancelo to put the ball in the net, ending a 10-match goal drought in major international tournaments.

This goal marked his 144th international goal in 230 appearances, both of which are current records for men's internationals.

Having made his World Cup debut in 2006, Ronaldo has scored in every single finals since then.

His goal against Uzbekistan also equalled Eusebio's record of nine goals at the global finals for Portugal.

headline_marked: Dhaka infrastructure alarm: [[Road collapse swallows shop]] in Mohammadpur
headline: Dhaka infrastructure alarm: Road collapse swallows shop in Mohammadpur
summary: Sinkholes and subsidence in Dhanmondi and Mohammadpur have raised serious concerns over the city's overall infrastructure safety.
details: A road collapse in Mohammadpur has swallowed a shop, leaving nearby buildings at risk of further subsidence.
This incident follows reports of a sinkhole appearing in Dhanmondi, adding to the growing alarm over the stability of Dhaka's roads and infrastructure.
Local residents and business owners are concerned that similar collapses could happen in other parts of the city.
The incidents highlight critical vulnerabilities in the city's urban planning and road maintenance systems.
caption:
A shop swallowed by the road! Dhaka's infrastructure is raising alarms as sinkholes appear in Mohammadpur and Dhanmondi.

A road collapse in Mohammadpur has swallowed a shop, leaving nearby buildings at risk of further subsidence.

This incident follows reports of a sinkhole appearing in Dhanmondi, adding to the growing alarm over the stability of Dhaka's roads and infrastructure.

Local residents and business owners are concerned that similar collapses could happen in other parts of the city.

The incidents highlight critical vulnerabilities in the city's urban planning and road maintenance systems.
